load_speechbrain_asr_model: load a speechbrain ASR model from hparams using EncoderDecoderASR and wrap it in WrapAsrModel
run_asr_forward_pass: run a forward pass on audio input through WrapAsrModel to transcribe speech to text
configure_asr_model: configure the ASR model with ModelConfig specifying source and savedir for the speechbrain model
get_asr_transform: get an empty Compose transform for the ASR model using get_transform with inference and model config
review_wrapasrmodel_forward: review the WrapAsrModel forward method that normalizes audio, encodes batches, and decodes predicted tokens to text
